{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hall of Justice''' was a section inside the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

[[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] and [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]], an [[New Republic Intelligence|Intelligence]] operative, visited there during their [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] on Coruscant.
